skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of economic and technical norms, their role, significance, and organizational structure in market economy management.
Grasp the methods and components of economic norms, and develop solutions to reduce consumption and save materials in production.
Analyze and manage the implementation of economic and technical norms, and quality management according to ISO standards.
Apply knowledge of logistics and supply chain management to develop systems for economic and technical norms.
Demonstrate teamwork skills and analyze the construction and management of economic norms in specific businesses.
Understand social context and professional ethics, and take responsibility for sustainable practices and circular economy.
Analyze and manage standardization and quality according to ISO standards.
Identify opportunities and develop systems for economic and technical norms to solve logistics and supply chain issues.
Develop skills to solve problems related to logistics and supply chain management.
Demonstrate independence and responsibility in work and group settings.
Express and defend personal views based on objective and scientific approaches.
